selected_frontier: Test concurrent conflicting payloads and cross-key ordering for the freshness-free materialized-state class, including crash between content-key materialization and logical-pointer publication.
planned_atomic_boundary: One deterministic symbolic probe only: two concurrent writers from one prior logical root plus one causally ordered two-key update encoded both naively and through a single immutable manifest root. Controls: stale replay, duplicate retry, winner selection, lost-update detection, and crash after content materialization before logical-root publication.
